preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 20, inclusive.
The number of nodes in the tree is between 2 and 200,000, inclusive.
The number of queries is between 1 and 200,000, inclusive.
Each node's value is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The nodes are numbered between 1 and N, inclusive.
The nodes in each query are distinct.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 500000
preconditions.description: The total number of nodes across all test cases does not exceed 500,000.

preconditions.expression: The sum of Q over all test cases does not exceed 500000
preconditions.description: The total number of queries across all test cases does not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.expression: For each query, the output is the minimum absolute difference between any two nodes on the simple path between a and b.
postconditions.description: The output for each query is the minimum absolute difference between any two nodes on the simple path between the given nodes a and b.
